component.name: VibeLauncher
component.summary: Minecraft launcher with mods and modpacks

description.p: VibeLauncher installs, manages and launches Minecraft: Java Edition. It keeps separate instances with their own game version, mod loader, mods and modpacks, signs in with a Microsoft account and downloads the Java runtime each game version needs.
VibeLauncher is not an official Minecraft product and is not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
